generation_params.prompt:
Create a reusable animation production CHARACTER IDENTITY MASTER reference sheet, 3840 x 2160 landscape 16:9, exactly nine clearly separated panels in a regular 3 x 3 grid. Short clean header: "CREW02 — BYTE". This is ONE established individual shown repeatedly, not a group, not a new design. Character age 18, youthful fully clothed anthropomorphic cat. Preserve the supplied original identity and costume exactly. IDENTITY LOCK: Male orange long-haired tabby, white muzzle, pink nose, round black sunglasses worn consistently, black-and-orange tech jacket and utility outfit, gold/orange glowing paw headphones around neck, tactical boots, orange striped fluffy tail. Preserve face roundness, orange fur pattern, glasses diameter and costume. Reference 1 ONLY the BYTE section at upper right supplies his outfit/turnaround; Reference 2 supplies his same face. Do not borrow any other cat's headset or hood.

VISUAL STYLE: rich realistic fur, expressive stylized cinematic cyberpunk character rendering and physically convincing worn fabric, leather, metal, glass. Neutral charcoal-grey studio backdrop and soft balanced key/fill lighting in ALL panels; small palette-correct practical glow, restrained rim light so all surfaces and fur are readable. No city backgrounds, no neon architecture, no dramatic scene, no cinematic cropping.

LAYOUT / DELIVERABLES, read left-to-right:
1 FRONT: full body neutral relaxed A-pose, straight frontal orthographic-like view, ears to boots with ample margins.
2 BACK: matching full body directly from rear, show exact tail attachment, back seams, equipment, boots. Same scale and outfit.
3 LEFT PROFILE: character's left side, head faces image left, exact side view full body.
4 RIGHT PROFILE: character's right side, head faces image right, exact opposite profile full body; rotate the actual design, NEVER mirror asymmetric markings/equipment.
5 FACE: large three-quarter head-and-shoulders identity close-up, signature eyewear or headphones and face clearly readable.
6 EXPRESSIONS: four clean bust close-ups of this same face: neutral, focused, amused, alarmed. Keep costume and worn eyewear unchanged. No new face design.
7 CONTROLLER GRIP: close-up of both correctly articulated feline paws holding a simple black twin-stick game controller, readable claw/finger placement, wrists continue into correct costume sleeves.
8 LAPTOP GRIP: waist-up view and paw close-up, one paw supporting a slim black closed/partly-open laptop while other paw uses keyboard/trackpad. Screen blank. Maintain same physical paw anatomy and costume.
9 COSTUME / ACCESSORIES: isolated laid-out fixed outfit and exact signature accessories, reference-matched front/back garment details, material/colour swatches. This is a breakdown of the SAME outfit worn in panels 1-8, NOT wardrobe alternatives.

Only short panel labels. No biographies, no voice names/IDs, no product slogans, no watermarks, no other characters. Every full body shows both arms, both legs, both ears and the complete tail if present. Preserve species, fur pattern, eye colour, cheek markings, goggle/headphone geometry and faction palette, fixed costume seam placement and accessories in all nine panels. Keep anatomical left/right consistent. No human skin or human hands, no extra digits/limbs, no duplicate tails, no alternate clothing, no sexualization.

passes: Orange tabby identity, white muzzle, round black glasses and orange paw headphones preserved.
Four full-body orientations and black/orange outfit, backpack, boots and striped tail are consistent at review scale.
All nine requested content sections present; controller/laptop grips readable.

issues.note: Nine sections use 4/2/3 rows, not a regular 3×3 grid.
Neutral and focused expressions are very similar behind opaque glasses; stronger mouth/ear variation is needed for a full acting sheet.
Controller and laptop are grip proxies. Scene controller identity must follow PROP03 (five-controller master); PROP01 is the CRT and PROP02 is the console.
